anchor: v2::Grace Odhiambo, ORD-20768. The leather hiking boots are half a size too small. Can I exchange them?

result.text:
Yes, ORD-20768 is eligible for a size exchange. It's 11 days past delivery, within the 30-day window, and there's no cost to exchange. The exchange works by starting a return for the wrong size and placing a new order for the correct size, and the replacement ships once the return is scanned.

What size would you like instead? Once you confirm, I'll start the return.

results.title: Exchanges
results.body: Footwear and apparel can be exchanged for a different size or color within 30 days of delivery at no cost. To exchange, start a return with reason "wrong_size" and place a new order; the replacement ships once the return is scanned.

results.title: Final sale
results.body: Items marked final sale (clearance) cannot be returned or exchanged. They are still covered by the warranty against manufacturing defects.
